title: Stage 08 Sign-off and Deploy Gate
description: Stage 8 (PM Sign-off + Deploy) gate. Codex collapses claude's separate stage-07 (sign-off) and stage-08 (deploy) into a single gate. Authored by the pm agent for sign-off OR the orchestrator on the auto-fold path when Stage 7 (QA) passes cleanly with a 1:1 criterion mapping; deploy fields populated by dev-platform after the adapter runs.

pm_signoff.description: PM (or auto-fold) confirms acceptance criteria are met. Deploy cannot proceed without this.

deploy_requested.description: True when the user wants the run to proceed past sign-off into deploy; false marks the run complete at sign-off.

runbook_referenced.description: Confirms pipeline/runbook.md exists with §Rollback and §Health signals. Required for deploy PASS — a missing runbook ESCALATEs at deploy start.

adapter.description: Selected deploy adapter name from .codex/config.yml (one of docker-compose, kubernetes, terraform, custom).

smoke_test_passed.description: Adapter-driven smoke test result. Populated by dev-platform after the adapter runs.
